title: 5 Days Challenge
statement: Alice is undertaking a 5-day reading challenge. She has n books, where the i-th book contains pages[i] pages. Alice wants to finish reading all the pages in exactly 5 days by distributing the pages as evenly as possible among the five days. Your task is to determine the minimum number of pages Alice has to read on any day after an optimal distribution. Note: Pages from a book can be distributed across multiple days.

examples.explanation: Total pages = 104. One optimal distribution is 20, 21, 21, 21, 21. The minimum pages read in a day is 20.
Total pages = 5. Distribution across 5 days is 1, 1, 1, 1, 1. Minimum pages in a day = 1.

hints: Hint 1: Since pages can be distributed freely across days, only the total number of pages matters.
Hint 2: To distribute total pages as evenly as possible across 5 days, calculate total = sum(pages).
Hint 3: The minimum pages read on any day is floor(total / 5), which is total / 5 using integer division.
discussion: Consider large sum values (up to 2 * 10^14) requiring 64-bit integer types in C++ and Java.
